name: cut
description: Cuts out selected fields or character ranges from each line of input.

flags.description: Invert the selection (all fields except the listed ones).

examples.explanation: Prints the username (first colon-separated field) of every account.
Prints characters 1 through 3 of each line.

about: cut is a simple, fast slicer. Its main limitation: consecutive delimiters are each treated as a separator, so cut struggles with whitespace-aligned output (use awk for that) and cannot re-order or repeat columns.
useCases: Pull a single column from delimited data.
Shorten git hashes: git log --pretty=format:%h | cut -c1-7.
mistakes: Using -d' ' with cut on space-aligned columns — consecutive spaces create empty fields; awk handles this correctly.
